topics.label: Relational Model
topics.desc: Codd's model representing data as relations (tables) of tuples over typed attributes, the theoretical basis of SQL databases.

topics.label: Relational Algebra
topics.desc: Formal operator set (selection, projection, join, union, difference) defining query semantics and grounding query optimization.

topics.label: Keys & Constraints
topics.desc: Primary, foreign, unique, and check constraints that enforce entity and referential integrity within the relational schema.

topics.label: Functional Dependencies
topics.desc: Attribute determination relationships (X→Y) underpinning candidate keys and the normalization theory that removes redundancy.

topics.label: Normalization
topics.desc: Decomposing relations into 1NF through BCNF to eliminate update anomalies while preserving dependencies and lossless joins.

topics.label: Relational Calculus
topics.desc: Declarative tuple/domain logic formalism equivalent in power to relational algebra, basis for non-procedural query languages.

topics.label: Domains & NULL Semantics
topics.desc: Attribute typing and three-valued logic where NULL means unknown, producing nonintuitive results in comparisons and aggregates.

topics.label: DDL
topics.desc: Data Definition Language (CREATE, ALTER, DROP) defining tables, schemas, and constraints that structure the database.

topics.label: DML & SELECT
topics.desc: Core data manipulation (SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE) expressing set-oriented retrieval and modification of rows.

topics.label: Joins
topics.desc: Combining rows across tables via inner, outer, cross, and self joins on predicates, the workhorse of relational queries.

topics.label: Aggregation & Grouping
topics.desc: GROUP BY with aggregate functions and HAVING filters that summarize rows into computed per-group results.

topics.label: Subqueries & CTEs
topics.desc: Nested queries, correlated subqueries, and WITH common table expressions that compose and modularize complex SQL logic.

topics.label: Window Functions
topics.desc: OVER/PARTITION analytic functions computing running totals, ranks, and lags without collapsing rows like aggregation.

topics.label: Recursive Queries
topics.desc: Recursive CTEs traversing hierarchies and graphs (org charts, bills of materials) by iterative self-referential evaluation.

topics.label: ACID Properties
topics.desc: Atomicity, consistency, isolation, and durability guarantees that make multi-statement database operations reliable.

topics.label: Isolation Levels
topics.desc: ANSI levels (read uncommitted to serializable) trading anomalies like dirty/phantom reads against concurrency throughput.

topics.label: Concurrency Anomalies
topics.desc: Read/write hazards (dirty read, non-repeatable read, phantom, write skew, lost update) that weaker isolation permits.

topics.label: Locking & 2PL
topics.desc: Shared/exclusive locks and two-phase locking protocols that serialize conflicting access to guarantee isolation.

topics.label: MVCC
topics.desc: Multiversion concurrency control giving readers consistent snapshots without blocking writers via per-transaction row versions.

topics.label: Deadlock Detection
topics.desc: Detecting cyclic lock waits via wait-for graphs and resolving them by victim selection, timeouts, or ordering.

topics.label: Write-Ahead Logging
topics.desc: Logging changes before applying them, enabling crash recovery and durability via redo/undo, formalized by ARIES.

topics.label: Serializability Theory
topics.desc: Conflict and view serializability defining when concurrent schedules are equivalent to some serial execution.

topics.label: B-Tree Indexes
topics.desc: Balanced multiway search trees enabling logarithmic point lookups and range scans, the default index in relational engines.

topics.label: LSM Trees
topics.desc: Log-structured merge trees buffering writes in memory and compacting sorted runs, optimizing write-heavy NoSQL stores.

topics.label: Hash Indexes
topics.desc: Hash-table indexes giving O(1) equality lookups but no range support, used for in-memory and specialized access paths.

topics.label: Page & Buffer Management
topics.desc: Fixed-size disk pages, slotted-page row layout, and a buffer pool caching pages to mediate memory and disk.

topics.label: Row vs Columnar Storage
topics.desc: Row stores favor OLTP point access; column stores favor OLAP scans via compression and vectorized aggregation.

topics.label: Secondary & Covering Indexes
topics.desc: Non-clustered indexes on non-key columns, with covering and composite indexes that satisfy queries without table access.

topics.label: Specialized Indexes
topics.desc: Bitmap, inverted, GiST, and R-tree structures serving full-text, low-cardinality, and spatial query workloads.

topics.label: Query Planner
topics.desc: Component translating declarative SQL into an executable physical plan tree by choosing operators and access paths.

topics.label: Cost-Based Optimization
topics.desc: Estimating I/O and CPU cost of candidate plans from statistics to select the cheapest, the core optimizer strategy.

topics.label: Cardinality Estimation
topics.desc: Predicting intermediate result sizes from histograms and statistics; the largest source of optimizer plan errors.

topics.label: Join Algorithms
topics.desc: Nested-loop, hash, and sort-merge join implementations whose selection drives execution cost on large inputs.

topics.label: Join Ordering
topics.desc: Searching the exponential space of join sequences via dynamic programming or heuristics to minimize intermediate sizes.

topics.label: Execution Engines
topics.desc: Iterator (Volcano) versus vectorized and compiled execution models that move tuples through the operator pipeline.

topics.label: Statistics & EXPLAIN
topics.desc: Table statistics feeding the optimizer and EXPLAIN/ANALYZE plan output used to diagnose and tune slow queries.

topics.label: CAP & Tradeoffs
topics.desc: The consistency-availability-partition tolerance tradeoff motivating NoSQL's choice of availability under network splits.

topics.label: Key-Value Stores
topics.desc: Simplest NoSQL model mapping opaque keys to values for low-latency caching and session storage (Redis, DynamoDB).

topics.label: Document Databases
topics.desc: Schemaless JSON/BSON document stores enabling flexible nested data and aggregate-oriented access (MongoDB, Couchbase).

topics.label: Wide-Column Stores
topics.desc: Column-family databases with sparse, partitioned rows scaling write-heavy workloads horizontally (Cassandra, HBase).

topics.label: Graph Databases
topics.desc: Native node-edge stores optimizing traversal and relationship queries via index-free adjacency (Neo4j, traversal langs).

topics.label: Time-Series & Specialized DBs
topics.desc: Engines optimized for timestamped, append-mostly data with retention and downsampling (InfluxDB, TimescaleDB).

topics.label: Eventual Consistency
topics.desc: Replicas converging over time, with quorum reads/writes and conflict resolution trading staleness for availability.

topics.label: Entity-Relationship Modeling
topics.desc: Conceptual design of entities, attributes, and relationships with cardinalities, the bridge from requirements to schema.

topics.label: Schema Design
topics.desc: Translating logical models into physical tables, types, and constraints balancing integrity, performance, and evolution.

topics.label: Denormalization
topics.desc: Deliberately introducing redundancy to avoid joins and accelerate reads, trading write complexity and consistency risk.

topics.label: Dimensional Modeling
topics.desc: Star and snowflake schemas of fact and dimension tables structuring data warehouses for analytic queries (Kimball).

topics.label: Schema Migration & Evolution
topics.desc: Versioned, reversible schema changes applied safely to live databases without downtime or data loss.

topics.label: Data Type & Key Selection
topics.desc: Choosing column types, surrogate vs natural keys, and identifier strategies (UUID, sequence) shaping storage and joins.

topics.label: Polyglot Persistence
topics.desc: Selecting different storage technologies per workload within one system rather than forcing one database to fit all.

topics.label: ETL & ELT
topics.desc: Extract-transform-load pipelines moving and reshaping data between sources and analytic stores, ELT pushing transform to the warehouse.

topics.label: Data Warehouse
topics.desc: Central integrated analytic store of cleaned historical data optimized for OLAP reporting and business intelligence.

topics.label: Data Lake & Lakehouse
topics.desc: Raw, schema-on-read object storage of all data, with lakehouse table formats adding ACID and warehouse semantics.

topics.label: OLAP & Analytics
topics.desc: Multidimensional analysis with roll-up, drill-down, and slice operations over aggregated measures across dimensions.

topics.label: Batch vs Stream Processing
topics.desc: Bounded batch jobs (Spark) versus unbounded low-latency stream processing (Flink) over continuous event data.

topics.label: Change Data Capture
topics.desc: Streaming row-level changes from a source's transaction log to keep downstream stores and pipelines in sync.

topics.label: Data Quality & Governance
topics.desc: Validation, lineage, cataloging, and orchestration ensuring trustworthy, discoverable, and reproducible pipeline data.

topics.label: Partitioning & Sharding
topics.desc: Splitting tables by range/hash and distributing shards across nodes to scale storage and query throughput horizontally.
